overview_description.description: Moov is rebuilding banking infrastructure for a cloud-native world without any legacy technology dependencies. Moov’s banking-as-a-service platform takes a developer-first approach of being open-source, portable to cloud providers or on-premises, modular for customization, and decoupled from any single bank program. Their protocols offer the first de facto standard for embedded payment infrastructure offered publicly.

about_short_description.short_description: Moov is a fintech platform that allows businesses to include transactional banking while also transmitting, receiving, and holding money.

product.name: Moov Platform
product.description: A unified payment infrastructure enabling acceptance, storage, sending, and spending of money through one integration and legal agreement.

product.name: Moov Drops
product.description: Prebuilt web components for embedding customizable payment and onboarding user interfaces with minimal coding.

product.name: Moov Dashboard
product.description: A progressive web app for managing payments, accounts, transfers, and user permissions across devices.

product.name: Data Sync
product.description: A service that continuously syncs Moov payment data to a customer’s data warehouse for analysis and reporting.

product.name: Onboarding
product.description: An automated onboarding solution that collects user data, performs KYC/KYB compliance, and verifies accounts to enable payment capabilities.

product.name: Send Money (Payouts and Disbursements)
product.description: A payment service to send instant or scheduled payouts to bank accounts and debit cards via multiple payment rails.
